newsitem.title: USA: Bolivia reissues crude tender for lack of offers.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia reissues crude tender for lack of offers.

text.p: Bolivia's state-owned oil company has reissued a tender for 260,000 barrels of reconstituted crude oil after receiving only one offer by last Friday, trade sources said Monday.
An Argentine company was the sole bidder, testifying to the continued oversupply in the crude market, sources said.
Yacimientos Petroliferos Fiscales Bolivianos (YPFB) will receive bids in the new tender through April 21.
The cargo loads at the Chilean port of Arica on May 7. The original tender called for loading April 15.
YPFB is holding the tender on its own behalf, as well as in the name of equity producers YPF, Perez Companc, Tesoro and Diamond Shamrock, the sources said.
The reconstituted crude has an API gravity of around 45 degrees. --Patricia Garip-Bertuol NY Energy Desk ((+1 212 859 1620))
